messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PD Alert fired: PD-8642 — capacity: inference-queue-length > 2000 for 3m (region: us-west-2). Autoscaler not catching up.

pagerduty: PD-8642 assigned to oncall (Maya K). Pager escalations enabled.

Maya K: acknowledged. joining. quick status? :eyes:

Tom S: saw this spike a minute ago, queue length jumped after a batch of large-context requests from customer X. Autoscaler logs show scale decisions queued but nodes not provisioning — hitting GCP GPU quota errors.

Raj P: confirmed quota errors in controller logs: `failed to create instance: QUOTA_EXCEEDED (GPUS)`. Also seeing `node-provision timeout` in the provisioner.

Maya K: ok — if quota is the blocker autoscaler can't do anything. Can we failover to warm pool or smaller model variants?

Sylvie L: warm pool is at max for this cell. We can try routing to cpu-backed fallthrough pool (higher latency) for non-critical routes. That will drop throughput but keep requests flowing.

Nora C: customer-impact note: internal metrics show 18% of requests 5xx-ing now, mostly long-gen (>=8k tokens). Support has flagged a small set of enterprise customers seeing timeouts.

Maya K: immediate mitigations: 1) attempt manual spot surge in us-west-2; 2) enable cpu fallthrough for non-enterprise routes; 3) notify support to throttle problematic customers if needed. I'll start 1 & 2.

Tom S: starting manual spike request to cloud: `gcloud compute instances create --accelerator type=nvidia-tesla-a100,count=1 --zone=us-west2-a --project=redwood-prod` — will paste logs.

oncall-bot: Deploy/infra action started by Tom S: manual GPU instance spawn (request id: r-9f3b).

Tom S: cloud responded with `quota exceeded: GPUs` at 4812350180. raised support ticket with cloud provider.

Raj P: while cloud handles quota request, I'm updating routing: enabling cpu-fallthrough flag for /v1/generate and /v1/chat for tier=free. Command: `rdctl route update --fallthrough=cpu --routes=/v1/generate,/v1/chat --policy=nonenterprise`

Sylvie L: done. fallthrough enabled — telemetry shows a drop in 5xx for free tier requests within ~30s, but latency for those requests up ~2.1s. Enterprise routes still backlog.

Maya K: pinging support: @support-team please contact the flagged enterprise customers and let them know we're mitigating; ask them to defer large-context runs for next 30m.

Nora C: support notified at 4812350285. Ticket created: SR-9921.

pagerduty: PD-8642 acknowledged by Maya K at 4812350300. Escalation suspended for 15m.

Maya K: adding temporary autoscaler policy change: `--allow-fallback-models=true` to route to lower-memory model family for enterprise routes if queue > 1500. Applying now.

Tom S: applied fallback-models flag. Routing tests look OK — enterprise traffic trickling through on smaller model (quality degrade expected).

Raj P: cloud provider support replied: quota increase request submitted but estimated time ~45-60m. They recommended using different accelerator family (T4) in another zone as workaround.

Sylvie L: cannot change enterprise SLAs to T4 automatically. We need opt-in. Suggest: keep fallback-models for 20m, monitor error surface, retry quota in parallel.

Maya K: agreed. actions summary: (1) manual instance spawn failed due to quota; (2) cpu fallthrough enabled for free tier; (3) fallback-models enabled for enterprise routes; (4) support contacted customers; (5) cloud quota in flight. We'll keep PD open until auto-scaler recovers or queue < 200 for 10m.

Nora C: customer impact update: 5xx rate down to 6% from 18% after mitigations. Logged customers: CustA, CustB, CustC — all notified.

oncall-bot: Checkpoint — queue length: 980 (was 2,150 at peak). Avg latency normalized for critical routes: 1.2s; fallback routes: 3.8s.

Maya K: handing off to night oncall (Raj) — I'll remain reachable for 10m then hand to you. Raj please monitor PD and queue, escalate if provider ETA slips.

Raj P: taking handoff. will wait for cloud quota update and keep PD open if queue increases. Running a quick sweep of autoscaler metrics and node events.

pagerduty: PD-8642 reassigned to Raj P at 4812350560.

Maya K: leaving a short postmortem note: root cause likely GPU quota exhaustion in us-west-2 combined with a burst of long-context requests. Short-term mitigations: routing fallbacks and manual flags. Long-term actions: request quota bump, add cross-zone prewarm pools, improve autoscaler backoff/parallelism for provisioning, and add early-request throttling for very long-gen jobs.

Raj P: noted. Will open incident ticket (INC-2026) and attach logs + timeline.

Sylvie L: adding alert tuning: adjust autoscaler alert to include `quota-exceeded` condition so next time it pages infra owner directly.

Nora C: support will follow up with customers after incident closes.

Maya K: thanks team. leaving channel. :thumbsup:

Raj P: monitoring. will close PD once queue stable <200 for 10m.

incident-bot: PD-8642 closed by Raj P at 4812350600 (reason: mitigations applied, queue stabilized).
